scenes.summary: Spark finds a map and plans an adventure.
scenes.text: Spark the dragon finds a treasure map and decides to search with his friend Timmy.
scenes.image_prompt: small dragon holding map with turtle friend cartoon style
scenes.story: Spark found a treasure map and went on an adventure with Timmy the turtle. They traveled through nature and reached a cave. Inside, they found a treasure chest with gems. They realized their friendship was more valuable than the treasure. They shared the treasure and returned home happy.
